rules.text: Overwhelming Illusions: a creature that succeeds raises its jutsu costs by the rank (D +4 ... S +20) until the end of its next turn.

castOption.label: Onijutsu: Overwhelming Illusions (1 Oni-Coil)
castOption.note: a creature that succeeds raises its jutsu costs by the rank (D +4 ... S +20) until the end of its next turn.

system.description: When a creature succeeds their saving throw against the amplified Genjutsu, until the end of their next turn, they increase the cost of jutsu they cast by an amount equal to the rank of the amplified jutsu. (D-Rank: +4, C-Rank: +8, B-Rank: +12, A-Rank: +16, S-Rank: +20)
